sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: A character's people/species choice and its official feature package.
When: Use at character creation and when ancestry fiction clearly explains how a PC perceives or approaches a moment.
Not When: Do not invent a mechanical bonus because a species detail sounds useful; use advantage or a lower Difficulty only when Kyle chooses that adaptation.
Answer: Use the printed ancestry feature. For scene flavor, give a distinct clue angle without changing math unless the table grants advantage or adjusts Difficulty.
Example: A Katari ranger may smell mineral wrongness in a package clue, but the roll is still Instinct unless a feature says otherwise.
Aliases: species elf human katari ribbet giant
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
